findings.text: `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` still contains spec/design authoring work instead of only concrete implementation and verification work. Specifically, Phase 1 says `Add validation scratch-root requirements and keep them aligned with the final helper behavior` and `Decide the override surface and default disk-backed scratch layout for checked-in heavyweight validation helpers`, but `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` already adds the requirements, and `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` already sets the resolution order and repo-local `target/` default. At the tasks stage, leaving requirements/design as TBD makes the work non-final and non-verifiable.

No task explicitly covers the startup-diagnostics behavior required by `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` under `Scenario: Operator override is respected`, which requires that the helper `reports that selected path in its startup diagnostics`. Current tasks mention `explicit override` and `low-space diagnostics`, but not implementing or verifying selected-path reporting on normal helper startup.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` Decision 1 says the helper should `fail fast if no usable disk-backed scratch root can be established`, but `tasks.md` only covers low-space preflight for `the selected scratch filesystem`. There is no task to implement or test the no-usable-root path when default repo-local scratch cannot be created/used and no override is supplied.

The change does not define the explicit scratch override interface that tasks and tests must implement. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` says resolution starts with “explicit operator override,” and `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` requires failures to name “the override mechanism that can redirect it,” but neither artifact names an env var, flag, or config path. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` only says “resolves scratch root from explicit override first” and adds coverage for “explicit override.” Without a named mechanism, the required diagnostic and regression behavior are not testable.

The low-space preflight requirement is not specified tightly enough for deterministic implementation or regression coverage. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` says helpers “MUST estimate whether the selected scratch filesystem has enough free space” and that “the exact probe mechanism may vary,” while `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` requires an early failure when scratch “lacks enough free space.” `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` then requires “regression coverage for ... low-space diagnostics.” There is no defined threshold, configured minimum, or injectable probe seam, so “enough” is ambiguous and the test task is not well-specified.

Earlier artifacts define scope as plural “checked-in heavyweight validation entry points,” but tasks only target `scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh`. See `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/proposal.md` (“checked-in heavyweight validation entry points”), `design.md` (same plural scope), and `specs/validation/spec.md` (“checked-in heavyweight validation entry points”). In contrast, `proposal.md` Impact and `tasks.md` only name `scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh`. Evidence is insufficient to show that this script is the only in-scope entry point; either narrow the spec/design scope or add tasks for all in-scope helpers.

The regression task does not explicitly verify the requirement that both temp files and Cargo artifacts are routed under the selected scratch root. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` says the selected root “MUST drive both Cargo artifact output and temporary-file placement,” but `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` only lists coverage for “default selection, explicit override, selected-path startup diagnostics, unusable default-root failure, and low-space diagnostics.” Add an explicit verification item for `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` placement.

The docs task needs a constraint to avoid reintroducing a known proof-runner failure pattern. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` says “Document direct `cargo` guidance for disk-backed `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`.” The napkin notes that raw `cargo test -p crunch --test self_hosting -- --ignored --nocapture` can SKIP due to missing `bwrap` and that `./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh` should be used instead. The current artifacts do not conflict with that, but the docs task should avoid using raw self-hosting proof commands as the recommended example.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` drops a required exception from earlier artifacts. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` Decision 2 and `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` both say the helper must route `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` under the selected scratch root only **unless the operator explicitly overrides one of those variables**. The Phase 2 task says only “Route `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` through selected scratch-root subdirectories for proof-helper runs,” and the regression task lists placement coverage but no preservation-of-override coverage. Required behavior is unassigned and unverified.

Preflight verification does not fully trace the earlier artifacts. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` Decision 3 says the free-space probe should support regression tests with values “below and above the 4 GiB threshold,” and `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` requires the helper to exit “before the long compile or proof build begins” on low space. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` only assigns coverage for “below-threshold free-space diagnostics”; it does not assign an above-threshold/boundary success check or a check that heavy proof work is not started after a failing preflight.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` requires authoring tests (`"Add regression coverage for default scratch selection, ..."`), but it never requires executing the affected regression command or proof-helper test suite after implementation. The only explicit run step is `"Run openspec validate avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures"`, which validates OpenSpec artifacts, not the helper behavior. This leaves the change without an implementation verification task even though `proposal.md` and `design.md` both frame this as behavior that must be covered and validated. The napkin also warns that cheap Cargo probes like `cargo test -- --list` are not sufficient verification in this repo, so the missing execution step is not safely implied.

The single Phase 3 checkbox in `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` bundles many distinct behaviors: default scratch selection, `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR`, preserved explicit `TMPDIR`/`CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, startup diagnostics, unusable scratch-root failure, below-threshold preflight failure, and at-or-above-threshold success. That makes scenario-to-test traceability weak against `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md`, which separates default scratch behavior, explicit override behavior, and early capacity-preflight failure into distinct requirements/scenarios.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` Decision 1 and `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` Phase 1 require startup diagnostics to report both the selected scratch root and whether it came from `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` or the default repo-local policy, but `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` only requires diagnostics in `Scenario: Explicit proof scratch override is respected` and only says the helper "reports that selected path in its startup diagnostics." The delta spec does not currently require provenance-bearing diagnostics for default-vs-override selection, so the tasked behavior is under-specified.

The tasks do not explicitly verify the per-variable override behavior required by `design.md` Decision 2 and `specs/validation/spec.md` Requirement "The selected scratch root MUST drive both `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` through subdirectories under that root unless the operator explicitly overrides one of those variables." `tasks.md` only says "Add regression coverage for `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` selection and preserved explicit `TMPDIR`/`CARGO_TARGET_DIR` overrides," which can be satisfied by testing both overrides together and still miss the cases where only `TMPDIR` is preset or only `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` is preset.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` Phase 3 uses the example `cargo test -p crunch --test self_hosting -- --nocapture` for regression execution, but the napkin records that raw `cargo test` here still needs the full clang/pkg-config/openssl PATH setup and that proof-related validation can fail for environment reasons. If this example remains, it should name the required environment/setup or point to the checked-in helper/wrapper to avoid false negatives during task execution.

The tasks do not explicitly cover positive verification that unset `TMPDIR` and unset `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` are both routed under the selected scratch root. Evidence: `proposal.md` says testing must cover "`TMPDIR`/`CARGO_TARGET_DIR` placement"; `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` requires that "The selected scratch root MUST drive both `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` through subdirectories under that root" and its scenario ends with "the helper routes both `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` under that selected root"; `tasks.md` only names override-preservation tests ("Add regression coverage for preserved explicit `TMPDIR`-only overrides" and "Add regression coverage for preserved explicit `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`-only overrides") plus default/override scratch selection diagnostics, but no explicit regression task for the non-overridden placement behavior.

The design's deterministic testability requirement for the 4 GiB preflight is not traced into tasks. Evidence: `design.md` Decision 3 says, "Implementation: expose the free-space probe behind a narrow helper seam so regression tests can inject values below and above the 4 GiB threshold." `tasks.md` includes "Implement the fixed 4 GiB free-space preflight" and regression coverage for below/above threshold outcomes, but no task calls for adding that seam or an equivalent deterministic mechanism for injecting free-space values.

The override contract is internally inconsistent. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/proposal.md` says the helper should “name a single override interface,” and `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` repeats the goal to keep scratch selection “overridable through one named interface,” with Decision 1 naming `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR`. But Decision 2 in `design.md`, the added requirement in `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` (“unless the operator explicitly overrides one of those variables”), and `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` tasks to “Preserve explicit `TMPDIR`” and “Preserve explicit `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`” all treat `TMPDIR`/`CARGO_TARGET_DIR` as additional operator-facing override paths. That conflict must be resolved before tasks are actionable, because it changes what behavior is intended and what tests should prove.

The tasks do not explicitly require verification of the mandatory low-space error text. `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` requires the below-threshold failure to name the selected scratch root and `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` as the redirect mechanism. `tasks.md` includes an implementation task for that message, but the verification task only says “Add regression coverage for ... below-threshold preflight failure before proof work starts, and at-or-above-threshold preflight success,” which can pass without asserting the required diagnostics content.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` Decision 2 says "`CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` is the only operator-facing override interface" and "`TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` remain helper-managed outputs, not additional public override knobs." `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` only says "Route both `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` through selected scratch-root subdirectories" and "Add regression coverage that both `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` are placed under the selected scratch root." There is no task to verify the helper overrides or ignores inherited ambient `TMPDIR`/`CARGO_TARGET_DIR`. Without that, the single-interface contract is unverified.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` includes "Add regression coverage for unusable scratch-root failure," and `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md` Decision 1 says "If neither path is usable, the helper MUST fail before the proof starts." But `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` has no requirement or scenario for unusable scratch-root behavior. Tasks are currently carrying behavior that is not traced into the delta spec.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` says "Run targeted proof-helper regression tests with the documented nightly/clang/pkg-config env setup and confirm the new scratch-selection/preflight tests PASS," but it does not name the exact command or the doc/source for that setup. The supplied napkin build-environment entries show repeated false negatives from incomplete setup (`cc`, `pkg-config`, `openssl`, `bwrap`). As written, the verification step is not deterministic enough to gate completion.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` includes the scenario **"No usable proof scratch root fails before proof work"** and requires that the error **"names `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` as the scratch redirect interface"**. In `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md`, the matching tasks are only **"Implement proof-scratch resolution in `scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh`: use `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` when set, else `target/self-hosting-proof/work/`, and fail if no usable scratch root can be established"** and **"Add regression coverage for unusable scratch-root failure"**. Neither task requires that the failure message include `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` guidance, so a mandatory spec behavior lacks explicit implementation and verification traceability.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` says to **"Run `cargo test -p crunch --test self_hosting -- --nocapture` with the exact PATH/PKG_CONFIG_PATH setup documented in `AGENTS.md`"**, but the supplied napkin records that fresh raw `cargo test` attempts can fail for non-code reasons when `/tmp` tmpfs fills and advises using disk-backed `TMPDIR`/`CARGO_TARGET_DIR` before trusting the result. The task text does not say how this verification step avoids the same ambient `/tmp` failure mode this change is addressing.

The assistant’s final response misreported the gate status. It says `openspec_gate` “stopped with `openspec-gate: empty reviewer output`,” but the supplied transcript shows multiple concrete `openspec_gate` results with findings, including a final visible run after the last edits at `12:37:30` with `VERDICT: FAIL`. Calling the work done while the latest shown gate is failing is overclaimed completion.

There is no evidence of a passing `openspec_gate` after the final edits. The only successful check shown is `bash: Change 'avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures' is valid`, which supports `openspec validate`, not task/spec readiness. The latest visible stage-gate evidence remains `VERDICT: FAIL`, so the OpenSpec is not verified as ready from the supplied evidence.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` requires running raw `cargo test -p crunch --test self_hosting -- --nocapture` for verification. The supplied napkin records this path as a known source of false negatives in this repo: bare `cargo test` can fail for missing `cc`/`pkg-config`/`openssl`, and even with the usual toolchain prefix it can SKIP with `bwrap not on PATH`; the napkin recommends `./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh` for proof-related validation. As written, that verification step is not deterministic from the evidence provided.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` still requires a raw verification command: `Run TMPDIR=target/test-scratch/tmp CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/test-scratch/cargo-target cargo test -p crunch --test self_hosting -- --nocapture with the exact PATH/PKG_CONFIG_PATH setup documented in AGENTS.md...`. That task does not use the repo-approved proof helper and does not fully specify the known environment constraints for this repo. The supplied napkin records that raw `cargo test` can fail for non-code reasons because the full toolchain PATH is missing (`failed to find tool "cc"`) and can still skip because `bwrap` is not on PATH; it explicitly says to use `./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh` because the helper prepends bubblewrap and validates prerequisites. This conflicts with the last user prompt, which required replacing or tightening the raw cargo task so it covers known toolchain and `bwrap` requirements.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` ends with `Run openspec validate avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures`, but there is no task to re-run `openspec_gate` even though the supplied Last User Prompt explicitly says `Re-run openspec_gate and fix the remaining findings before calling the OpenSpec done.` This is a traceability gap against the current requested next steps.

The only explicit helper-run verification task in `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` is `Run TMPDIR=target/test-scratch/tmp CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR=target/test-scratch/proof ./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh --check and confirm the helper passes with the new scratch-selection/preflight behavior`. The napkin says `./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh --check only proves host prerequisites` and `do not archive proof-related OpenSpec changes based on --check alone.` No separate task runs the helper in a mode that exercises actual proof startup, or narrows this task to prerequisite-only validation. This should be blocked by a harder tasks-stage rule for proof-related env verification.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` still leaves the direct-`cargo` docs task underconstrained relative to `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md`. The design’s Decision 4 implementation says to “document a direct cargo example for a heavyweight non-proof validation command,” but the task text only says: “Document disk-backed `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` guidance for heavyweight direct `cargo` commands without replacing `scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh` as the canonical proof entry point.” That omission matters because the supplied napkin records that raw self-hosting cargo commands are environment-sensitive (`failed to find tool "cc"`, `SKIP: bwrap not on PATH`) and that `./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh` is the approved self-hosting entry point. Tighten the task so it cannot drift back into documenting raw self-hosting proof commands without the exact required environment.

The smoke verification task is still host-dependent and does not pin the repo-approved prerequisite environment needed to prove the scratch-change behavior. Evidence: `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` says to run `TMPDIR=target/test-scratch/tmp CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR=target/test-scratch/proof ./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh --check`. The supplied napkin says `./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh --check` “only proves host prerequisites,” and the prior gate prompt required verification to use either the repo-approved proof helper or “an exact environment setup that covers the known toolchain and bwrap requirements.” This task now uses the helper, but it still omits the exact prerequisite environment, so failure can still reflect ambient host setup rather than the scratch selection change.

The tasks do not explicitly pin the branch where `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` is set but unusable, and the helper must fail instead of silently falling back to `target/self-hosting-proof/work/`. Evidence: `design.md` Decision 1 says the helper “MUST resolve its scratch root from `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` when that environment variable is set” and only falls back when it is unset. `tasks.md` only has the generic implementation task “use `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` when set, else `target/self-hosting-proof/work/`, and fail if no usable scratch root can be established” plus a generic “Add regression coverage for unusable scratch-root failure,” which does not explicitly assert the no-fallback behavior for a bad explicit override.

The repeated env-fragile verification-task pattern should be promoted into an OpenSpec tasks-gate/template rule. Evidence: the user’s promotion hints explicitly call out repeated `[class=env] [scope=tasks]` findings and ask to “Strengthen OpenSpec tasks gate/template to block repeated env findings.” The current `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` still contains a verification command whose success depends on unspecified host prerequisites.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` plans to “Add regression coverage …” for default scratch selection, env rewrite, override provenance, unusable override, and threshold behavior, but it never includes a task to run that new regression suite. The only execution tasks are `Run ./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh --check ...`, `Run openspec validate avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures`, and `Re-run openspec_gate ...`. That leaves the spec scenarios in `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` unexecuted in the work plan.

The helper verification task in `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/tasks.md` says to run `./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh --check` with both `TMPDIR=target/test-scratch/tmp` and `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR=target/test-scratch/proof`. That conflicts with `openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/design.md`, Decision 2: “`CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` is the only operator-facing override interface for proof scratch selection in this change. `TMPDIR` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` remain helper-managed outputs of that selected root, not additional public override knobs.” The task currently asks operators to supply two scratch-related env knobs for the helper, which undermines the single-interface contract. This matches the repeated env/task drift called out in the promotion hints and should become a harder rule/template check.

`openspec/changes/avoid-tmpfs-validation-failures/specs/validation/spec.md` includes scenario `No usable proof scratch root fails before proof work` for the case where `CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` is unset and the repo-local `target/self-hosting-proof/work/` path cannot be created or used. `tasks.md` only adds regression coverage for `an explicit unusable CRUNCH_PROOF_SCRATCH_DIR` with no fallback. There is no matching task to verify the env-unset/default-path-unusable failure path.
